title: Guided reading: Luke 15:20
subtitle: Follow a narrative participle and aorist sequence.
overview: This verse demonstrates how participles can establish the approach while finite aorists carry the father’s responses.
Keep the father’s actions distinct: saw, was moved with compassion, ran, fell upon, kissed.

items.grc: ἔτι δὲ αὐτοῦ μακρὰν ἀπέχοντος εἶδεν αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ.
items.en: While he was still far away, his father saw him.

items.grc: καὶ δραμὼν ἐπέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτόν.
items.en: And having run, he fell upon his neck and kissed him warmly.
